notes: Complete independent reading of scan 004 only. Whole image (1691×2361), top half (1691×1260), and bottom half (1691×1261, original y origin 1100) were each viewed once, in that order. Only tight crops were viewed afterward. No OCR, recognition library, PDF text layer, web, other page, or other reader was used.

Read the supplied brief, conventions, preamble, notation_before_scan004, and C/H/S page packet. The main reader subsequently supplied H_drawings/01-1.tex and the same-page H drawing supplement, which were read and compared. H’s graph is therefore treated as supplied, not absent.

The page introduces graphs through vertex and edge sets and incidence, gives an axiom and a large graph example, defines strict graphs, names arcs, describes a topological realization via segments, and begins rectilinear realization in a finite-dimensional real vector space.

Graphes is the underlined page topic; Def and Graphe are separate underlined labels at the left of the data brace. There is no date or authorial page number. The lower-left 3 is archive foliation and is present only as a comment.

No authorial question word or explicit question mark was observed. The finite-graph parenthesis has two trailing points, and the vector-space parenthesis has an ellipsis. All unsure macros are editorial reading uncertainty.

The graph’s paths, lens-shaped curves, isolated segment, isolated point, and small detached ink stroke are reproduced in TikZ. A small dark patch at the upper junction is preserved without using it to assert a graph-theoretic vertex count. The small attachment diagram is reproduced with the drawn cap sign, not a substituted arrow.

The surplus existential-like sign in the axiom, singular 2 sommet, singular ses sommet, and awkward possible Si a X= are preserved rather than regularized from mathematical or grammatical expectations.

The quotation-glyph differences and added abbreviation points in H are recorded; macro-only syntax, the archive identifier in H’s page marker, and H’s editorial note formatting are not counted. The live realization heading is transcribed from ink without making H’s emph macro alone a difference.

S.json is empty: there are no sweep rows to confirm or overturn. All 17 C doubt loci have individual dispositions. New doubts are the repeated small coordinate index, the mark after X in the attachment sentence, and the compressed par ending.
